subject: sounds
title: Where Is the Sound?
about: Hear a short word and one sound, then tap where that sound lives: at the beginning, in the middle or at the end (the mmm in ham is at the end, the short a in bat is in the middle). This is NC RF.1.3.c, isolating the first, middle-vowel and last sound of a spoken one-syllable word, turned around so he has to place a given sound instead of naming one.
tip: Say the word slowly with three fingers up, one per sound, and ask which finger the sound lands on: first, middle or last.

cards.q: Where do you hear the /m/ sound in ham?
cards.sayQ: Where do you hear the mmm sound in ham?
cards.note: ham: h - a - m. The mmm is the last sound, at the end.

cards.q: Listen to the word fan. Where is the /f/ sound?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word fan. Where is the fff sound?
cards.note: fan: f - a - n. The fff is the first sound, at the beginning.

cards.q: In the word mud, where is the /u/ sound, like in sun?
cards.sayQ: In the word mud, where is the uh sound, like in sun?
cards.note: mud: m - u - d. The short u is the middle sound. Vowel sounds sit in the middle of short words.

cards.q: Find the /k/ sound in kid. Where is it?
cards.sayQ: Find the kuh sound in kid. Where is it?
cards.note: kid: k - i - d. The kuh is the first sound, at the beginning.

cards.q: Where do you hear the /g/ sound in log?
cards.sayQ: Where do you hear the guh sound in log?
cards.note: log: l - o - g. The guh is the last sound, at the end.

cards.q: Listen to the word van. Where is the /v/ sound?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word van. Where is the vvv sound?
cards.note: van: v - a - n. The vvv is the first sound, at the beginning.

cards.q: Where do you hear the /a/ sound, like in hat, in the word bat?
cards.sayQ: Where do you hear the short A sound, like in hat, in the word bat?
cards.note: bat: b - a - t. The short a is the middle sound.

cards.q: In the word lid, where is the /d/ sound?
cards.sayQ: In the word lid, where is the duh sound?
cards.note: lid: l - i - d. The duh is the last sound, at the end.

cards.q: Find the /j/ sound in jog. Where is it?
cards.sayQ: Find the juh sound in jog. Where is it?
cards.note: jog: j - o - g. The juh is the first sound, at the beginning.

cards.q: Where do you hear the /p/ sound in zip?
cards.sayQ: Where do you hear the puh sound in zip?
cards.note: zip: z - i - p. The puh is the last sound, at the end.

cards.q: Listen to the word pet. Where is the /e/ sound, like in bed?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word pet. Where is the eh sound, like in bed?
cards.note: pet: p - e - t. The short e is the middle sound.

cards.q: Where do you hear the /w/ sound in wet?
cards.sayQ: Where do you hear the wuh sound in wet?
cards.note: wet: w - e - t. The wuh is the first sound, at the beginning.

cards.q: Listen to the word net. Where is the /t/ sound?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word net. Where is the tuh sound?
cards.note: net: n - e - t. The tuh is the last sound, at the end.

cards.q: In the word pot, where is the /o/ sound, like in hot?
cards.sayQ: In the word pot, where is the short O sound, like in hot?
cards.note: pot: p - o - t. The short o is the middle sound.

cards.q: Find the /y/ sound in yak. Where is it?
cards.sayQ: Find the yuh sound in yak. Where is it?
cards.note: yak: y - a - k. The yuh is the first sound, at the beginning. A yak is a big hairy ox.

cards.q: Listen to the word mitt. Where is the /i/ sound, like in pig?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word mitt. Where is the ih sound, like in pig?
cards.note: mitt: m - i - tt. The short i is the middle sound. tt is one sound.
